decision: Owner decision 13, docs/decisions/2026-10-15-owner-decisions.md: the Python candidate rootfs is built in CI and pinned by digest.
mirror: ghcr.io/<this repository>/python:3.13-slim (job python-base-image; copied from Docker Hub, ECR Public as fallback)
pinning: Both digests are null until the first candidate-rootfs CI run prints them; that job fails while either is null. Copy the printed values here in a reviewed edit, with the run URL as pinned_from. base_manifest_digest is the linux/amd64 image manifest, the same bytes on Docker Hub and in the mirror.
kept: var/lib/dpkg: the package database (data, not a tool), kept so the tree can be scanned for known vulnerabilities
sh, bash and perl from the Debian base, and Python's own socket module: general interpreters; the sandbox gives no network (runsc --network=none), so they reach nothing
setgid directories such as var/mail: group inheritance only; setuid/setgid bits are stripped from every regular file
extended attributes: tar in CI extracts none (no --xattrs), the digest covers any present except security.selinux, and a security.capability fails the audit
